_comment: Static, user-editable pool of liquid US stocks eligible for the tactical/satellite sleeve -- NOT the live trading list. scripts/refresh_tactical_universe.py intersects this with what Alpaca currently reports as active+tradable US equities, ranks the survivors by recent average dollar volume, and writes the top TACTICAL_UNIVERSE_SIZE of them to tactical_universe.json (which the engine actually reads). Edit this list freely -- add/remove tickers you want considered; nothing here is ever traded directly.
